rock_name: Weakly mineralised, altered melanocratic gabbro porphyry
texture: Porphyraceous; groundmass poikiloophitic, prismatic; structure massive
alteration: Serpentine, saussurite, talc, actinolite, carbonate; plagioclase altered to sericite-chlorite-epidote-carbonate; olivine to talc-serpentine pseudomorphs
opaque_minerals: Ilmenite-chromite-magnetite-pyrrhotite-chalcopyrite paragenesis; pyrrhotite as irregular grains and micro-lenses replacing chromite and ilmenite
description_summary: Hornblende and altered-olivine phenocrysts (60-65%) in a poikiloophitic groundmass of zoned plagioclase and mafic minerals. Olivine is pseudomorphed by talc-serpentine; quartz-carbonate amygdales and lenses 0.5-3.0 mm occur. Ore minerals (ilmenite, chromite, magnetite, pyrrhotite, chalcopyrite) occur in minor amounts, pyrrhotite associated with talc-serpentine pseudomorphs.

rock_name: Mineralised cordierite-actinolite metasomatite
texture: Lepidogranonematoblastic; structure weakly parallel, lens- and veinlet-like
alteration: Sericite; serpentine micro-lenses
opaque_minerals: Ilmenite-pyrite-magnetite-pyrrhotite-chalcopyrite-sphalerite paragenesis; pyrrhotite dominant as irregular grains, lenses and streaks replacing magnetite/ilmenite and replaced by chalcopyrite
description_summary: Strongly mineralised metasomatite of unevenly distributed cordierite and actinolite similar to samples 41.4 and 53.4. Coarse tabular cordierite (0.5-3.0 mm) with undulatory extinction hosts actinolite inclusions; fibrous actinolite forms nematoblastic radial aggregates. Ore minerals intergrown with cordierite, actinolite and probable serpentine; sphalerite carries micro-inclusions of chalcopyrite and pyrrhotite.

rock_name: Mineralised spinel-cordierite-actinolite metasomatite (micro-gneiss)
texture: Heterolepidogranonematoblastic; structure weakly parallel, lens- and veinlet-like
alteration: Hornblende partially altered to actinolite; serpentine micro-lenses
opaque_minerals: Ilmenite-pyrite-magnetite-pyrrhotite-chalcopyrite paragenesis; chalcopyrite in lens-like and banded clusters 0.5-8.0 mm wide; euhedral green spinel intergrown with magnetite
description_summary: Banded metasomatite (similar to samples 41.4, 53.4, 61.3) of cordierite, pyroxene, actinolite, biotite, garnet, muscovite and spinel; hornblende-actinolite-quartz bands with coarse pyrite and chalcopyrite 1-8 mm wide. Intensely mineralised; ore minerals grow in association with all silicates including euhedral square spinel grains.

rock_name: Silicified and mineralised serpentinite with biotite-chlorite
alteration: Silicification (quartz veins/lenses 0.5-2.0 mm), chloritization, carbonate
opaque_minerals: Pyrite-chalcopyrite paragenesis; pyrite as euhedral to irregular grains 0.1-2.0 mm in lens-shaped aggregates within serpentine, rimmed/replaced by chalcopyrite; chalcopyrite micro-lenses in quartz veins
description_summary: Serpentine-dominated rock (relict six/eight-sided olivine shapes) with abundant biotite flakes and chlorite lenses, crosscut by quartz veins from silicification. Field description: meta-sediment. XRD-identified minerals include quartz, muscovite, pyrite, clinochlore and lizardite. Mineralisation forms micro-lenses and veinlets of pyrite and chalcopyrite with serpentine, chlorite, carbonate and quartz.

rock_name: Carbonated and mineralised quartz vein
alteration: Carbonatization (carbonate veins 0.01-1.0 mm cutting quartz)
opaque_minerals: Pyrite-goethite-chalcopyrite paragenesis; euhedral pyrite 0.1-1.5 mm in lens/vein aggregates along carbonate veins, overgrown by goethite; chalcopyrite micro-grain lenses
description_summary: Quartz vein of granoblastic isometric quartz (0.1-1.5 mm, undulatory extinction) cut by minor carbonate veins and lenses along which ore formation occurred. Pyrite dominates, associated with carbonate veins and rimmed by goethite; minor chalcopyrite overgrows pyrite edges.

rock_name: Altered plagio-rhyolite (plagio-granite porphyry)
texture: Porphyroblastic; groundmass felsitic, locally micro-aplitic; structure massive
alteration: Plagioclase strongly altered to sericite, pelite, carbonate, muscovite; biotite locally to chlorite and rutile; epigenetic carbonate veins 0.02-0.1 mm
opaque_minerals: Pyrite-magnetite paragenesis; euhedral magnetite 0.05-0.1 mm occasionally replacing pyrite; sparse cubic pyrite 0.01-0.1 mm
description_summary: Porphyritic felsic rock with plagioclase (oligoclase An28-29, 0.8-8.5 mm) and rounded quartz phenocrysts (30-35%) in a felsitic quartz-albite-biotite groundmass with minor K-feldspar. Phenocrysts strongly sericitized/carbonatized with fresh zoned rims; rock cut by thin carbonate veins. Accessories: sphene, zircon, apatite; ore minerals magnetite and pyrite in trace amounts. Sample labelled "111.8" in the doc; hole CRS01A inferred from report context.

source_file: English Petrographic and Mineragraphic description. 15.docx (Innova Mineral)
rock_name: Mineralised amphibole-plagioclase gneiss (formed from gabbro-diorite)
texture: Nematogranoblastic, relict porphyroblastic, relict hypidiomorphic; structure gneissic, lens-like
alteration: Plagioclase completely albitized; actinolite after amphibole
opaque_minerals: Magnetite-pyrrhotite-chalcopyrite paragenesis, evenly disseminated; magnetite replaced by pyrrhotite, pyrrhotite by chalcopyrite; euhedral pyrite in quartz aggregates; magnetite-pyrrhotite-millerite crystal noted in microphoto
description_summary: Gneiss of albite, actinolite and quartz aligned in one direction (nematogranoblastic) with relict poikilitic/hypidiomorphic textures indicating a gabbro-diorite protolith. Significantly mineralized, ore minerals associated with both albite and actinolite growth; lenticular quartz granoblastic clusters host euhedral pyrite.

source_file: English Petrographic and Mineragraphic description. 15.docx (Innova Mineral)
rock_name: Mineralised and altered fine to medium grained peridotite with hornblende (melanocratic gabbro?)
alteration: Serpentinization (veins along pyroxene cleavage), saussurite, talc, actinolite
opaque_minerals: Chromite-magnetite-pentlandite-pyrrhotite-chalcopyrite paragenesis; ore lenses 0.8-7.0 mm; pyrrhotite dominant, replaced by chalcopyrite; pentlandite replaced by pyrrhotite and millerite; possible PGE/white-gold group micrograins 0.005-0.01 mm
description_summary: Hornblende peridotite / melanocratic gabbro dominated by monoclinic pyroxene with serpentinized olivine, brown hornblende and biotite; interstitial basic plagioclase slightly saussuritized. Strong Ni-Cu style mineralization as evenly distributed sulfide lenses linked to serpentinization of the ultramafic-mafic intrusive; high-reflectance white micrograins may be precious-metal phases requiring analysis.

source_file: English Petrographic and Mineragraphic description. 15.docx (Innova Mineral)
rock_name: Mineralised gneiss with quartz-actinolite-albite (metasomatite formed from gabbro-diorite)
texture: Lepidonematogranoblastic, relict porphyroblastic, relict hypidiomorphic; structure gneissic, lens-vein like
alteration: Plagioclase albitized; deformed granoblastic recrystallization
opaque_minerals: Pyrite-magnetite-pyrrhotite-chalcopyrite-sphalerite paragenesis evenly distributed; chalcopyrite lens-like microaggregates replacing pyrrhotite and magnetite; sphalerite with chalcopyrite inclusions
description_summary: Similar to sample 41.4: albite-actinolite-biotite-quartz gneiss with relict porphyroblastic/hypidiomorphic textures after gabbro-diorite. Quartz granoblastic lens/vein zones 5-7 mm wide contain actinolite needles and ore minerals. Strongly mineralized with chalcopyrite notably abundant (8-10%).

source_file: English Petrographic and Mineragraphic description. 15.docx (Innova Mineral)
rock_name: Mineralized, serpentinized, fine- to medium-grained hornblende-bearing peridotite
texture: Relict hypidiomorphic, poikilitic, occasionally sideronitic; structure massive, net
alteration: Intense serpentinization (pseudomorphs with relict 6-8-sided olivine outlines), talc, actinolite, saussurite
opaque_minerals: Magnetite-pyrite-pentlandite-pyrrhotite-chalcopyrite paragenesis; ore lenses 1.0-8.0 mm; pyrrhotite dominant (0.8-6.0 mm) rimmed by chalcopyrite; fine magnetite veinlets in serpentine; minor euhedral pyrite and chromite
description_summary: Similar to sample 42.3: serpentine pseudomorphs after olivine (with relict olivine remnants) and pyroxene, strongly replaced marginally by brown hornblende; minor biotite and saussuritized plagioclase. Intense sulfide mineralization as evenly distributed lenses tied to serpentinization of the ultramafic-mafic intrusive.

source_file: English Petrographic and Mineragraphic description. 15.docx (Innova Mineral)
rock_name: Mineralised, serpentinized, fine to medium grained hornblende peridotite
texture: Relict hypidiomorphic, poikilitic, occasionally sideronitic; structure massive, net
alteration: Serpentinization, saussurite, talc, actinolite, iddingsite; fuchsite after hornblende margins
opaque_minerals: Magnetite-pentlandite-pyrrhotite-chalcopyrite paragenesis; pyrrhotite 80-85% of ore minerals in lenses 0.5-7.0 mm; magnetite fine-grained intersecting veinlets in serpentine; pentlandite replaced by pyrrhotite and millerite
description_summary: Similar to samples 42.5 and 76.6: magnetite-bearing serpentine pseudomorphs after olivine/pyroxene with hornblende, biotite-fuchsite and minor saussuritized plagioclase. Intense mineralization as magnetite veinlets along serpentine fractures plus evenly distributed sulfide lenses related to serpentinization.

source_file: English Petrographic and Mineragraphic description. 15.docx (Innova Mineral)
rock_name: Altered quartzose microdiorite
alteration: Sericite, pelite, saussurite, actinolite, chlorite; epigenetic carbonate veinlets 0.1-0.5 mm
opaque_minerals: Titanite-pyrite paragenesis only; leucoxenized titanite 0.03-0.2 mm associated with hornblende; sparse fine pyrite 0.01-0.05 mm
description_summary: Strongly altered microdiorite: plagioclase almost completely sericitized/saussuritized retaining relict prismatic form; hornblende heavily altered to actinolite and carbonate; sparse interstitial quartz with poikilitic inclusions. Essentially unmineralized; crosscut by carbonate(-actinolite) veinlets.

source_file: English Petrographic and Mineragraphic description. 15.docx (Innova Mineral)
rock_name: Mineralised, altered, fine to medium grained pyroxene-biotite-hornblende gabbro
alteration: Serpentine, epidote, actinolite, chlorite; plagioclase cores altered to sericite-actinolite-epidote
opaque_minerals: Magnetite-pentlandite-pyrrhotite-chalcopyrite paragenesis; chalcopyrite and magnetite dominant, lens-like accumulations 0.5-5.0 mm; possible platinum-group micrograins 0.005-0.01 mm
description_summary: Gabbro of zoned mafic plagioclase, brown hornblende (with monoclinic pyroxene relicts), biotite and serpentinized olivine pseudomorphs. Intense mineralization forms relatively large evenly distributed ore lenses texturally associated with plagioclase and mafic minerals; chalcopyrite is notably abundant. Tiny high-luster white grains possibly PGM.

source_file: English Petrographic and Mineragraphic description. 15.docx (Innova Mineral)
rock_name: Mineralised and serpentinized, fine to medium grained hornblende peridotite
texture: Relict hypidiomorphic, poikilitic, occasionally sideronitic; structure massive, net
alteration: Partial serpentinization (olivine/pyroxene not fully pseudomorphed), saussurite, talc, actinolite, iddingsite; fuchsite
opaque_minerals: Magnetite-pentlandite-pyrrhotite-chalcopyrite-sphalerite paragenesis; ore lenses 0.5-6.0 mm, pyrrhotite ~80% of lenses; millerite noted; white-gold group micrograins 0.005-0.01 mm
description_summary: First of two slides labelled OVD-21-116.1. Identical macro/microscopically to samples 42.5 and 76.6 but olivine and pyroxene only partially serpentinized. Intense mineralization: magnetite veinlets in serpentine plus evenly distributed pyrrhotite-dominated sulfide lenses related to serpentinization of the ultramafic-mafic intrusive.

source_file: English Petrographic and Mineragraphic description. 15.docx (Innova Mineral)
rock_name: Mineralised, serpentinized, fine to medium grained hornblende peridotite
texture: Relict hypidiomorphic, poikilitic, in parts sideronitic; structure massive
alteration: Serpentinization, saussurite, talc, actinolite; fuchsite and iddingsite
opaque_minerals: Magnetite-pentlandite-pyrrhotite-chalcopyrite-sphalerite paragenesis; ore lenses 0.5-7.0 mm; pyrrhotite up to 7.0 mm rimmed/replaced by chalcopyrite (itself a dominant ore mineral, 0.1-2.5 mm); grey sphalerite 0.1-0.2 mm with chalcopyrite-pyrrhotite inclusions; white-gold group grains 0.004-0.01 mm
description_summary: Second slide of sample OVD-21-116.1 ("There was 2"). Generally identical to samples 42.5 and 76.6: serpentine pseudomorphs after pyroxene/olivine with hornblende, biotite-fuchsite and minor plagioclase. Intense sulfide mineralization tied to serpentinization; chalcopyrite and pyrrhotite dominant.

source_file: English Petrographic and Mineragraphic description. 15.docx (Innova Mineral)
rock_name: Mineralised, serpentinized, fine to medium grained hornblende peridotite
texture: Relict hypidiomorphic, poikilitic, in parts sideronitic; structure massive
alteration: Serpentinization, saussurite, talc, actinolite, iddingsite; fuchsite associated with olivine/serpentine
opaque_minerals: Magnetite-pentlandite-pyrrhotite-chalcopyrite paragenesis; ore lenses 0.5-6.0 mm evenly distributed; fine magnetite veinlets along serpentine cleavage; chalcopyrite 0.1-2.0 mm replacing/rimming pyrrhotite
description_summary: Generally identical to sample 116.1: serpentine pseudomorphs (with talc, actinolite, biotite, fuchsite, iddingsite) after olivine/pyroxene plus dark hornblende and minor strongly saussuritized plagioclase. Intense mineralization as evenly distributed sulfide lenses related to serpentinization of the ultramafic-mafic intrusive.

source_file: English Petrographic and Mineragraphic description. 15.docx (Innova Mineral)
rock_name: Mineralised, serpentinized, fine to medium grained hornblende peridotite
texture: Relict hypidiomorphic, poikilitic, in parts sideronitic; structure massive
alteration: Serpentinization, saussurite, talc, actinolite, iddingsite; fuchsite
opaque_minerals: Magnetite-pentlandite-pyrrhotite-chalcopyrite paragenesis; ore lenses 0.5-6.0 mm; pyrrhotite 0.2-6.0 mm rimmed/replaced by chalcopyrite (0.1-2.5 mm); pentlandite 0.1-0.3 mm
description_summary: Generally identical to sample 146.9: serpentine pseudomorphs after olivine/pyroxene, dark hornblende, biotite-fuchsite and minor saussuritized plagioclase. Intense sulfide mineralization as evenly distributed lenses related to serpentinization; magnetite fine veinlets along serpentine cleavage.

source_file: English Petrographic and Mineragraphic description. 15.docx (Innova Mineral)
rock_name: Mineralised, altered gabbro-porphyry
texture: Porphyritic; groundmass ophitic, poikilo-ophitic; structure massive
alteration: Sericite, epidote, serpentine, saussurite, actinolite, carbonate, talc; pseudomorphs of actinolite-carbonate-talc after pyroxene; carbonate veins
opaque_minerals: Magnetite-pentlandite-pyrrhotite-chalcopyrite paragenesis; magnetite euhedral 0.05-0.3 mm with mafic minerals; pyrrhotite-hornblende lens aggregates 0.5-1.8 mm; pentlandite micro-lenses rimmed by pyrrhotite and chalcopyrite
description_summary: Gabbro porphyry with hornblende and altered plagioclase phenocrysts in a subophitic groundmass of plagioclase, hornblende, minor monoclinic pyroxene and biotite. Hosts xenoliths of medium-fine hornblende gabbro (1-15 mm) carrying identical ore minerals. Mineralization mostly disseminated with sulfide micro-lenses; chalcopyrite intergrown with actinolite-carbonate-talc pseudomorphs.

source_file: English Petrographic and Mineragraphic description. 15.docx (Innova Mineral)
rock_name: Mineralised chlorite-sericite bearing micro-schist
texture: Microgranolepidoblastic, porphyritic; structure schistose, lenticular, spotted, veinlet-like
alteration: Sericite pseudomorphs after cordierite (sectored-extinction lenses); secondary quartz and carbonate
opaque_minerals: Titanite-pyrite-chalcopyrite paragenesis; pyrite as cubic disseminations 0.05-0.3 mm and clustered veins 0.5-1.0 mm cutting foliation; sparse chalcopyrite micrograins; 2-3 bright-white grains possibly silver
description_summary: Micro-schist of unidirectionally aligned chlorite-sericite; sericite lens aggregates with single-centered sectored extinction interpreted as pseudomorphs after cordierite. Mineralized with disseminated pyrite and pyrite veins along foliation; crosscut by minor carbonate-quartz veins carrying ore minerals. Microphotos labelled 168.8 (minor caption inconsistency vs sample 168.3).

source_file: English Petrographic and Mineragraphic description. 15.docx (Innova Mineral)
rock_name: Carbonatized and silicified altered andesite
alteration: Carbonatization and silicification; phenocrysts fully pseudomorphed by quartz-carbonate-chlorite; quartz-carbonate amygdales 0.6-2.5 mm (15-20%)
opaque_minerals: Pyrite-pyrrhotite-chalcopyrite paragenesis (plus ilmenite), mostly within quartz-carbonate-chlorite amygdales; euhedral pyrite 0.1-2.0 mm; 2-3 bright white grains possibly silver/PGM
description_summary: Amygdaloidal andesite with phenocrysts completely replaced by quartz-carbonate-chlorite pseudomorphs (after plagioclase and probable hornblende) in a relict microlitic groundmass with glass-derived chlorite. Abundant quartz-carbonate amygdales host the ore minerals; chalcopyrite micrograins locally resemble gold in appearance.

source_file: English Petrographic and Mineragraphic description. 15.docx (Innova Mineral)
rock_name: Altered alkali, quartzose diorite porphyry
texture: Porphyritic; groundmass micro-hypidiomorphic, prismatic; structure massive
alteration: Sericite, epidote, chlorite, rutile, actinolite, carbonate; epigenetic carbonate and epidote lenses/veinlets 0.05-0.8 mm; mafic phenocrysts fully pseudomorphed by epidote-chlorite with rutile exsolution
opaque_minerals: Ilmenite-pyrite-pyrrhotite-chalcopyrite paragenesis associated with altered mafic minerals; ilmenite prismatic/skeletal, slightly leucoxenized; sparse pyrite and chalcopyrite micrograins partly in epidote lenses; 2-3 bright white grains likely silver
description_summary: Diorite porphyry with strongly sericitized/epidotized plagioclase phenocrysts (some K-feldspar rimmed) and epidote-chlorite pseudomorphs after biotite/hornblende in a plagioclase-quartz-K-feldspar groundmass with micrographic intergrowths. Weakly mineralized: mainly ilmenite plus trace sulfides and probable silver micrograins.

rock_name: Weakly mineralised, altered melanocratic gabbro porphyry
alteration: Serpentine, saussurite, talc, actinolite, carbonate; plagioclase to sericite-chlorite-epidote-carbonate; olivine to talc-serpentine pseudomorphs
opaque_minerals: Ilmenite-chromite-magnetite-pyrrhotite-chalcopyrite paragenesis in minor amounts; pyrrhotite micro-lenses with talc-serpentine pseudomorphs, displacing chromite and ilmenite
description_summary: Hornblende and altered-olivine phenocrysts (60-65%) in a poikilo-ophitic groundmass of zoned plagioclase and mafic minerals; olivine pseudomorphed by talc-serpentine; quartz-carbonate amygdules 0.5-3.0 mm. Weakly mineralised. Same sample as in the 6-sample report.

rock_name: Mineralised cordierite-actinolite metasomatite
alteration: Sericite; probable serpentine as brownish isotropic micro-lenses
opaque_minerals: Ilmenite-pyrite-magnetite-pyrrhotite-chalcopyrite-sphalerite paragenesis; pyrrhotite dominant as anhedral grains and lenses/veins 0.2-1.0 mm, displaced by chalcopyrite; sphalerite with chalcopyrite-pyrrhotite micro-inclusions
description_summary: Similar to samples 41.4 and 53.4 (Innova 15-sample report): unevenly distributed cordierite and actinolite in lepidogranonematoblastic texture; coarse cordierite hosts acicular actinolite; significant mineralisation intergrown with cordierite, actinolite and probable serpentine.

rock_name: Mineralised spinel-cordierite-actinolite metasomatite (micro-gneiss)
alteration: Pyroxene margins to actinolite; serpentine-iddingsite micro-lenses
opaque_minerals: Ilmenite-magnetite-pyrite-pyrrhotite-chalcopyrite paragenesis; chalcopyrite in lenticular/banded aggregates with veins 0.5-8.0 mm; euhedral green spinel intergrown with magnetite; coarse pyrite up to 2.5 mm
description_summary: Banded metasomatite (similar to 41.4, 53.4, 61.3) of cordierite, hornblende, actinolite, biotite, serpentine-iddingsite, muscovite and spinel; coarse pyroxene-quartz-sulfide lenses/bands 1-8 mm wide, possibly relicts of a basic/ultrabasic protolith. Strongly mineralised.

rock_name: Silicified, mineralised biotite-chlorite serpentinite
alteration: Silicification (quartz lenses/veins 0.5-2.0 mm), chloritization with carbonate
opaque_minerals: Pyrite-chalcopyrite paragenesis; pyrite 0.1-2.0 mm in lenticular aggregates mostly in serpentine, displaced marginally by chalcopyrite; chalcopyrite micro-lenses in quartz veins
description_summary: Serpentine (relict olivine shapes; XRD lizardite) with abundant biotite and chlorite lenses, crosscut by silicification quartz veins. Field description: meta-sediment. XRD-identified: quartz, muscovite, pyrite, clinochlore, lizardite. Numerous ore micro-lenses/veinlets with serpentine, chlorite, carbonate and quartz. Includes XRD note.

rock_name: Carbonatised, mineralised quartz vein
alteration: Carbonatisation: carbonate veins 0.01-1.0 mm crosscutting quartz
opaque_minerals: Pyrite-goethite-chalcopyrite paragenesis; euhedral pyrite 0.1-1.5 mm in lenses/veins 0.2-2.5 mm along carbonate veins, rimmed by goethite; chalcopyrite micro-grains displacing pyrite margins
description_summary: Granoblastic quartz vein (grains 0.1-1.5 mm, undulose extinction) cut by minor carbonate veins/lenses along which mineralisation occurred; pyrite dominant, goethite-rimmed.

rock_name: Plagiorhyolite (plagiogranite porphyry)
texture: Porphyritic; groundmass felsitic, locally micro-aplitic; massive, lenticular
alteration: Plagioclase strongly sericitized/carbonatized/muscovitized with fresh zoned rims; biotite locally to chlorite+rutile; epigenetic carbonate veins 0.02-0.1 mm
opaque_minerals: Magnetite-pyrite paragenesis, accessory only; euhedral magnetite 0.05-0.1 mm occasionally displaced by pyrite; rare cubic pyrite 0.01-0.1 mm
description_summary: Felsic porphyry: oligoclase (An28-29) and rounded quartz phenocrysts (30-35%) in felsitic quartz-albite-biotite groundmass with minor K-feldspar; accessory sphene, zircon, apatite. Essentially barren.

rock_name: Silicified, mineralised cordierite-serpentine-actinolite metasomatite
alteration: Silicification; late quartz-carbonate veins 0.5-5.0 mm; iddingsite after possible olivine relicts
opaque_minerals: Magnetite-pyrite-pyrrhotite-chalcopyrite paragenesis; ore lenses/veins 0.1-10.0 mm along late quartz-carbonate veins; chalcopyrite dominant, forms veins 0.5-2.0 mm displacing pyrite
description_summary: Similar to 61.3 and 81: serpentine-cordierite-actinolite metasomatite crosscut by late ore-quartz-carbonate veins 0.5-5.0 mm. Strong mineralisation both intergrown with silicates and as veins along the late quartz-carbonate stage.

rock_name: Silicified, mineralised serpentine-actinolite-cordierite metasomatite
texture: Heterolepidonematogranoblastic; weakly parallel, banded, lenticular, veined
alteration: Silicification; late idiomorphic quartz lenses/bands 1.0-10.0 mm (nearly barren); iddingsite after olivine relicts
opaque_minerals: Magnetite-pyrite-pyrrhotite-chalcopyrite paragenesis, evenly distributed; magnetite displaced by pyrite/pyrrhotite/chalcopyrite; pyrite micro-lenticular aggregates
description_summary: Similar to 61.3, 81 and 114.8: banded cordierite (1.0-5.0 mm prisms), actinolite and serpentine aggregates aligned in one direction; ore minerals intergrown with all three silicates, evenly distributed; late quartz bands nearly unmineralised.

rock_name: Silicified, mineralised serpentine-chlorite-cordierite metasomatite
texture: Heteronematogranolepidoblastic; weakly parallel, banded, lenticular, veined
alteration: Silicification; late quartz-carbonate veins 1.0-10.0 mm; carbonate-chlorite-serpentine in cordierite fracture zones
opaque_minerals: Magnetite-pyrite-pyrrhotite-chalcopyrite paragenesis; chalcopyrite dominant (0.02-0.6 mm), displacing pyrrhotite; pyrite-chalcopyrite lenses/veins 1.0-8.0 mm along late veins
description_summary: Serpentine-chlorite-cordierite metasomatite with lenticular/banded fabric, strongly mineralised; ore intergrown with silicates and as 0.5-8.0 mm lenses/veins along late quartz-carbonate veins.

rock_name: Silicified, mineralised cordierite-serpentine-chlorite metasomatite
texture: Heteronematogranolepidoblastic; weakly parallel, banded, lenticular, veined
alteration: Silicification; late quartz-carbonate veins 1.0-10.0 mm; serpentine(-talc) pseudomorphs with hexagonal-octagonal relicts; iddingsite micro-aggregates
opaque_minerals: Magnetite-pyrite-pyrrhotite-chalcopyrite paragenesis; pyrite lenses/veins 0.5-10.0 mm with chalcopyrite displacing/rimming it; chalcopyrite also intergrown with serpentine and chlorite
description_summary: Generally identical to sample 184.32; chlorite-serpentine dominated with coarse cordierite lenses; strong mineralisation intergrown with silicates and along late quartz-carbonate veins as 0.2-6.0 mm ore lenses/veins.

rock_name: Strongly brecciated, silicified, carbonatised, mineralised chlorite-serpentine metasomatite (chloritic serpentinite)
alteration: Intense silicification and carbonatisation; numerous quartz-carbonate-ore veins 0.1-10.0 mm giving breccia-like structure
opaque_minerals: Magnetite-pyrite-chalcopyrite paragenesis; pyrite veins predominate (0.5-15.0 mm wide, grains 0.2-3.0 mm), displaced by chalcopyrite; rare chromite micro-grains; chalcopyrite also intergrown with chlorite-serpentine
description_summary: Brecciated serpentinite: lenticular chlorite and serpentine aggregates (rare rhombic pyroxene relicts) crosscut by abundant quartz, carbonate and coarse ore veins; mineralisation accompanies the late carbonate-quartz stage.

rock_name: Highly altered gabbrodiorite porphyry (albite-chlorite-carbonate metasomatite)
texture: Relict porphyritic; groundmass relict prismatic granular, relict subophitic; weakly parallel
alteration: Near-total replacement by carbonate, chlorite, albite, sericite, quartz, leucoxene; carbonate(-quartz) veinlets 0.2-0.3 mm
opaque_minerals: Pyrite-chalcopyrite paragenesis; sparse euhedral pyrite 0.02-0.2 mm (some resembling pyrrhotite) and isolated chalcopyrite 0.01-0.05 mm with chlorite-carbonate
description_summary: Gabbrodiorite porphyry with plagioclase and mafic phenocrysts (20-25%) fully pseudomorphed by albite-carbonate and chlorite; abundant titanite micro-grains in chlorite pseudomorphs. Weakly mineralised.

rock_name: Serpentine-carbonate-actinolite-chlorite metasomatite (derived from gabbro or ultramafic rock)
alteration: Complete pseudomorphic replacement; epigenetic quartz and carbonate veinlets 0.5-2.0 mm
opaque_minerals: Titanite-pyrite paragenesis; euhedral pyrite 0.02-0.4 mm evenly distributed, locally micro-lenticular aggregates
description_summary: Fully metasomatised fine-grained melanocratic gabbro or ultramafic rock: idiomorphic hexagonal pseudomorphs (0.2-0.8 mm) of quartz-carbonate-chlorite-serpentine-actinolite after mafic minerals (pyroxene), plus chlorite pseudomorphs after hornblende with abundant titanite inclusions.

rock_name: Fine-grained hornblende gabbrodiorite
alteration: Plagioclase to sericite-carbonate-pelite (zoned, fresh rims); minor chlorite; late quartz-carbonate micro-lenses
opaque_minerals: Titanite-pyrite-chalcopyrite paragenesis from late weak mineralisation; sparse euhedral pyrite 0.03-0.2 mm and chalcopyrite micro-aggregates in quartz and chlorite
description_summary: Fresh-looking fine hornblende gabbrodiorite: intermediate zoned plagioclase with interstitial green-brown hornblende; rare chlorite pseudomorphs after biotite with rutile-titanite. Weak, late mineralisation only.

rock_name: Silicified, carbonatised and mineralised silty argillite
texture: Blastoaleuropelitic, matrix microlepidoblastic; massive, weakly breccia-like
alteration: Silicification and carbonatisation; carbonate-quartz lenses/veinlets 0.1-2.0 mm
opaque_minerals: Pyrrhotite-chalcopyrite; pyrrhotite lenses/veins 0.1-2.5 mm wide in carbonate-quartz veins, chalcopyrite micro-aggregates displacing its margins
description_summary: Cryptolepidoblastic clayey-sericite-chlorite argillite with rare relict silt quartz fragments; weak mineralisation associated with late quartz-carbonate veinlets (pyrrhotite dominant). XRD suggested for precise identification of the clay-mica aggregate.

rock_name: Weakly mineralised chlorite-sericite micro-schist (phyllite) derived from siltstone
alteration: Sericite-chlorite schistosity; spotted sericite lenses possibly after cordierite; leucoxene-altered titanite
opaque_minerals: Ilmenite-pyrite-chalcopyrite paragenesis; euhedral pyrite grains, micro-lenses and thin veinlets concentrated in a 10x25 mm aleuroargillite lens; dust-like pyrite in main mass; rare chalcopyrite 0.01-0.1 mm
description_summary: Phyllite of aligned sericite-chlorite with blastoaleuritic quartz relicts and meta-siltstone lenticles; a dark aleuroargillite lens is mineralised with abundant pyrite micro-lenses and veinlets.

rock_name: Carbonatised fine-grained feldspar-quartz sandy metasiltstone
alteration: Carbonatisation: carbonate micro-lenses 0.2-3.0 mm along schistosity; rare quartz micro-lenses
opaque_minerals: Titanite-pyrite paragenesis; micro-phenocrystic pyrite 0.01-0.1 mm evenly distributed, thin veinlets rimming carbonate lenses
description_summary: Folded metasiltstone: aligned quartz and albitised feldspar fragments (25-30%) in microlepidoblastic clayey-sericite-chlorite matrix; carbonate lenses along schistosity; weak pyrite mineralisation.

rock_name: Weakly carbonatised and mineralised silty argillite (siltstone)
alteration: Weak carbonatisation; quartz-carbonate veinlets 0.1-0.5 mm
opaque_minerals: Titanite-pyrite-chalcopyrite paragenesis; sparse micro-phenocrystic pyrite and chalcopyrite 0.01-0.1 mm; chalcopyrite micro-lenses in quartz-carbonate veins
description_summary: Siltstone of quartz(-feldspar) fragments in semi-isotropic pelitomorphic micaceous-clayey cement, weakly carbonatised and only sparsely mineralised.

rock_name: Mineralised and altered fine-grained melanocratic (olivine-hornblende) gabbro
alteration: Serpentine, saussurite, talc, actinolite, carbonate; olivine to talc-serpentine pseudomorphs; plagioclase to sericite-chlorite-epidote-carbonate
opaque_minerals: Chromite-magnetite-pyrrhotite-chalcopyrite paragenesis; pyrrhotite-chalcopyrite lens up to 8x20 mm associated with talc-serpentine pseudomorphs; chalcopyrite micro-grains in pseudomorphs
description_summary: Melanocratic gabbro of brownish-green hornblende, talc-serpentine pseudomorphs after olivine (0.3-1.8 mm) and zoned basic plagioclase; notable sulfide mineralisation as large pyrrhotite-chalcopyrite lenses tied to the pseudomorphs.

rock_name: Strongly altered medium-grained hornblende peridotite
alteration: Intense amphibolitisation (hornblende replacing pyroxene and olivine); serpentinization with talc-carbonate; coarse carbonate lenses 0.2-1.0 mm
opaque_minerals: Chromite-magnetite-pyrite paragenesis; only sparse micro-phenocrystic magnetite, chromite, pyrite (0.01-0.2 mm) and rare chalcopyrite with carbonate-serpentine
description_summary: Amphibolitised peridotite: dominant brownish-green hornblende displacing rhombic pyroxene relicts and serpentine(-talc-carbonate) pseudomorphs after olivine. Minimal mineralisation.

rock_name: Garnet-carbonate metasomatite (skarn)
alteration: Late carbonate veinlets 0.1-0.5 mm with rare pyrite veinlets
opaque_minerals: Pyrite-chalcopyrite paragenesis; sparse chalcopyrite 0.02-0.2 mm and pyrite in the quartz-carbonate mass; pyrite veinlets 0.1-0.2 mm in late carbonate veins
description_summary: Skarn of granoblastic calcite (strong HCl effervescence) with minor quartz and evenly distributed euhedral garnet porphyroblasts (0.3-1.5 mm). Sparse sulfides.

rock_name: Metasomatically strongly altered diorite porphyry
texture: Porphyritic; groundmass micro prismatic granular, microhypidiomorphic; massive
alteration: Sericite, pelite, chlorite, muscovite; epigenetic carbonate veinlets 0.1-0.3 mm; mafic phenocrysts fully to chlorite pseudomorphs with rutile
opaque_minerals: Chromite-pyrrhotite-chalcopyrite paragenesis; sparse chalcopyrite and pyrrhotite micro-grains with altered mafics; rare chromite in chlorite pseudomorphs; micro-prismatic pyrrhotite in carbonate veinlets
description_summary: Diorite porphyry with sericitized zoned plagioclase phenocrysts and chlorite pseudomorphs after biotite/hornblende in a plagioclase-mafic-quartz groundmass; weakly mineralised.

rock_name: Altered fine- to medium-grained pyroxene-hornblende gabbro
alteration: Sericite, pelite, serpentine, epidote, chlorite; plagioclase cores to sericite-epidote; olivine to chlorite-serpentine pseudomorphs
opaque_minerals: Magnetite-titanite-pyrite-chalcopyrite paragenesis; sparse micro-phenocrysts with mafics; skeletal leucoxenised titanite with chalcopyrite inclusions; euhedral pyrite 0.1-0.5 mm with pseudomorphs
description_summary: Slide A of sample 89.8: gabbro of zoned mafic plagioclase, brown hornblende with monoclinic pyroxene relicts, and chlorite-serpentine pseudomorphs after olivine. Weakly mineralised. (Mineral table first entry reads "altered pyroxene" but narrative describes plagioclase.)

rock_name: Mineralised and altered variably grained pyroxene-hornblende melanocratic gabbro
alteration: Sericite, pelite, epidote, chlorite, carbonate, quartz; olivine to talc-serpentine pseudomorphs
opaque_minerals: Magnetite-pyrite-pyrrhotite-chalcopyrite paragenesis; ore lenses 0.5-10.0 mm mainly with carbonate, some intergrown with talc-serpentine; pyrrhotite dominant (0.5-8.0 mm) rimmed by chalcopyrite
description_summary: Poikilo-ophitic gabbro dominated by coarse brown hornblende enclosing altered plagioclase and olivine; talc-serpentine pseudomorphs 0.6-2.0 mm. Mineralised with carbonate-associated sulfide lenses.

rock_name: Carbonatised and albitised epidote-pyroxene-garnet-carbonate skarn
alteration: Carbonatisation and albitisation; late coarse carbonate-albite veins/lenses 0.5-2.5 mm
opaque_minerals: Pyrrhotite-pyrite paragenesis, sparse; pyrrhotite 0.02-0.2 mm micro-lenses with serpentine and altered hornblende; rare pyrite in late carbonate veins
description_summary: Slide B of sample 89.8 (Cyrillic Б in source): complex skarn interpreted as gabbro-carbonate contact; garnet, calcite, pyroxene, epidote granoblastic aggregate with relict gabbro fragments; weakly mineralised.

rock_name: Mineralised and metasomatically strongly altered fine- to medium-grained peridotite
alteration: Pervasive talc-chlorite-serpentine after olivine and pyroxene; hornblende to actinolite-carbonate-chlorite pseudomorphs; late quartz-carbonate veins/lenses
opaque_minerals: Chromite-magnetite-pyrite-pentlandite-pyrrhotite-chalcopyrite paragenesis; ore lenses 0.8-30.0 mm occupying ~15-20% of section; pyrrhotite dominant (0.5-10.0 mm) rimmed by chalcopyrite, displacing pentlandite
description_summary: Strongly altered peridotite, significantly mineralised: large evenly distributed Ni-Cu sulfide lenses (with pentlandite) mostly bounded by late quartz-carbonate, some intergrown with talc-serpentine.

rock_name: Weakly mineralised carbonate-actinolite-chlorite metasomatite derived from gabbrodiorite
alteration: Complete metasomatic replacement by actinolite and chlorite pseudomorphs; carbonatisation (0.01-0.2 mm grains)
opaque_minerals: Chromite-ilmenite-pyrite paragenesis; evenly distributed pyrite 0.01-0.2 mm dominant; weakly leucoxenised prismatic ilmenite; rare chromite
description_summary: Gabbrodiorite fully replaced by actinolite-chlorite pseudomorphs with even fine carbonate; weak oxide-pyrite mineralisation only.

rock_name: Chlorite-sericite micro-schist (phyllite)
alteration: Leucoxene-altered titanite micro-grains, occasionally rimming spotted lenses
opaque_minerals: Titanite-chalcopyrite paragenesis; dust-like pyrite singles and rare chalcopyrite 0.01-0.1 mm
description_summary: Phyllite of aligned chlorite-sericite with spotted sericite lens aggregates (65-70 vol%); essentially barren apart from leucoxenised titanite and trace sulfides.

rock_name: Fine-grained hornblende gabbrodiorite
alteration: Sericite, carbonate, pelite; carbonatisation with carbonate lenses/veins 0.1-1.0 mm; biotite to chlorite
opaque_minerals: Chromite-titanite-pyrite-chalcopyrite paragenesis; euhedral pyrite in carbonate lenses; chromite with hornblende; skeletal leucoxenised titanite with biotite
description_summary: Gabbrodiorite of zoned intermediate plagioclase and interstitial brown hornblende with poikilitic quartz; weak late mineralisation tied to chlorite and carbonate.

rock_name: Fine-grained biotite-quartz diorite (microdiorite)
alteration: Sericite, pelite, chlorite, pelitomorphic carbonate; hydrogoethite coatings along fissures; biotite partly to chlorite pseudomorphs with rutile-titanite
opaque_minerals: Titanite-pyrite paragenesis; leucoxenised titanite micro-aggregates with biotite; rare pyrite and chalcopyrite micro-grains
description_summary: Microdiorite of altered tabular plagioclase and reddish-brown biotite with interstitial poikilitic quartz; essentially barren.

rock_name: Strongly carbonatised and altered gabbrodiorite porphyry
texture: Porphyritic; groundmass poikilo-ophitic, prismatic grained; massive
alteration: Intense carbonatisation: pseudomorphs after hornblende/olivine, fine secondary carbonate plus carbonate lenses/veins 0.2-2.5 mm; sericite
opaque_minerals: Ilmenite-chromite-pyrite-pyrrhotite-chalcopyrite paragenesis, sparse; pyrrhotite micro-lenses in late carbonate veins; chalcopyrite micro-aggregates in late quartz-carbonate veins
description_summary: Gabbrodiorite porphyry with 40-45% phenocrysts: carbonate-chlorite pseudomorphs after hornblende (relict cleavage preserved) and sericitized plagioclase; abundant apatite; weakly mineralised. NOTE: distinct from OVD-21-116.1 of the Innova report.

rock_name: Weakly mineralised and altered melanocratic gabbro porphyry
texture: Porphyritic; groundmass poikilo-ophitic, prismatic granular; massive
alteration: Serpentine, saussurite, talc, actinolite, carbonate, quartz; olivine to talc-serpentine pseudomorphs 2.0-5.0 mm
opaque_minerals: Ilmenite-chromite-magnetite-pyrrhotite-chalcopyrite paragenesis; pyrite-pyrrhotite-chalcopyrite lens 1x3 mm in carbonate lens; chalcopyrite micro-grains in talc-serpentine pseudomorphs
description_summary: Porphyritic melanocratic gabbro (60-65% hornblende and altered-olivine phenocrysts) similar to OVD20-60.6; weak mineralisation with sulfide lens in carbonate.

rock_name: Weakly mineralised and altered fine- to medium-grained melanocratic gabbro (hornblende peridotite)
texture: Poikilo-ophitic, ophitic, relict panidiomorphic; weakly parallel
alteration: Serpentine, saussurite, talc, chlorite, actinolite, rare carbonate
opaque_minerals: Chromite-ilmenite-magnetite-pyrite-pyrrhotite-chalcopyrite paragenesis; pyrite-chalcopyrite lens 0.5-1.0 mm rimmed by carbonate; thin pyrite veinlets rimming altered plagioclase
description_summary: Weakly aligned melanocratic gabbro/peridotite: brown hornblende and talc-serpentine pseudomorphs after olivine (0.7-4.5 mm) with minor zoned plagioclase; weak mineralisation.

rock_name: Weakly mineralised and altered fine- to medium-grained hornblende peridotite
alteration: Serpentinization: pseudomorphs plus weakly serpentinised olivine with serpentine-magnetite mesh veinlets along cleavage; saussurite, talc, chlorite, actinolite
opaque_minerals: Chromite-ilmenite-magnetite-pyrite-pyrrhotite-chalcopyrite paragenesis; magnetite veinlets in olivine; chalcopyrite-pyrrhotite lenses 0.4-1.0 mm (pyrrhotite dominant)
description_summary: Similar to OVD15-158.7 but with preserved partly-serpentinised olivine (0.5-3.0 mm) showing mesh-textured serpentine-magnetite veinlets; weak sulfide mineralisation.

rock_name: Strongly mineralised and altered fine- to medium-grained hornblende peridotite (with lenses of weakly mineralised pyroxene-hornblende gabbrodiorite)
texture: Porphyry-like, hypidiomorphic, poikilo-ophitic, ophitic; massive, lenticular
alteration: Sericite, pelite, actinolite, chlorite; talc-serpentine pseudomorphs after olivine
opaque_minerals: Magnetite-chromite-pyrite-pyrrhotite-chalcopyrite paragenesis; chalcopyrite-pyrrhotite-pyrite lenses 1.0-4.0 mm in amphibole-serpentine-talc sections and along the gabbrodiorite contact; pyrite dominant in lenses, chalcopyrite veinlets crosscut them
description_summary: Composite sample of three rock sections: main altered hornblende peridotite flanked by pyroxene-hornblende gabbrodiorite and strongly altered microgabbrodiorite as veins/lenses/xenoliths. Mineralisation concentrated in the peridotite and at contacts.

rock_name: Weakly mineralised and altered fine- to medium-grained pyroxene-hornblende gabbrodiorite
alteration: Sericite, pelite, minor epidote-chlorite; large carbonate lenses 1-4 mm; second section almost fully muscovite-sericite pseudomorphed
opaque_minerals: Ilmenite-pyrite-pyrrhotite-chalcopyrite paragenesis; ilmenite phenocrysts dominant; sulfide micro-grains and micro-lenses with mafics; chalcopyrite in carbonate lenses
description_summary: Two-part rock: medium-grained pyroxene-hornblende gabbrodiorite (65-70%, hosts nearly all mineralisation) cemented by metasomatically strongly altered microgabbrodiorite (35-40%, only fine ilmenite). Abundant apatite needles.

rock_name: Weakly mineralised and altered fine- to medium-grained pyroxene-hornblende gabbrodiorite
alteration: Sericite, saussurite, pelite; carbonate lenses 1-4 mm
opaque_minerals: Ilmenite-pyrite-pyrrhotite-chalcopyrite paragenesis; skeletal ilmenite with carbonate-filled interstices hosting chalcopyrite, prisms up to 10-15 mm long; pyrite-pyrrhotite-chalcopyrite lenses 1.0-8.0 mm (pyrite dominant, 0.5-3.5 mm)
description_summary: Identical to OVD15-175.5B: altered plagioclase-hornblende-pyroxene gabbrodiorite with fine strongly-altered sections in lower abundance; sulfide-oxide lenses intergrown with rock-forming minerals and late carbonate.

rock_name: Strongly mineralised and altered fine- to medium-grained hornblende peridotite
alteration: Serpentine, saussurite, talc, chlorite, actinolite; acicular pyrrhotite and chromite along relict cleavage in pseudomorphs
opaque_minerals: Chromite-magnetite-pyrite-pyrrhotite-chalcopyrite paragenesis; chalcopyrite-pyrrhotite lenses 0.8-15 mm occupying ~20-25% of section; pyrrhotite dominant, chalcopyrite veinlets 0.1-0.5 mm crosscutting
description_summary: Similar to OVD15-158.7/165.5 but strongly mineralised: main ore is evenly distributed chalcopyrite-pyrrhotite lenses up to 15 mm across (~20-25% of slide area).

rock_name: Weakly mineralised and altered melanocratic gabbro porphyry (porphyry-like fine-grained melanocratic gabbro)
alteration: Serpentine, saussurite, talc, actinolite, carbonate; plagioclase to sericite-epidote-carbonate
opaque_minerals: Ilmenite-chromite-magnetite-pyrite-pyrrhotite-chalcopyrite paragenesis; chalcopyrite-pyrrhotite-pyrite lenses 1-3 mm with serpentine-talc pseudomorphs and late quartz-carbonate lenses; chromite segregated in pseudomorphs
description_summary: Porphyry-like melanocratic gabbro: hornblende and talc-serpentine-pseudomorph segregations (50-55%) in plagioclase-dominated groundmass; weak mineralisation, pyrite-dominant lenses.

rock_name: Garnet-quartz-carbonate rock
opaque_minerals: Titanite-pyrite paragenesis; sparse leucoxenised titanite and white-yellow pyrite micro-grains, mostly with garnet and carbonate
description_summary: Calcite-dominated granoblastic rock with aligned fabric, polyhedral garnet porphyroblasts (0.1-0.4 mm, titanite-zircon inclusions) in lenticular/banded clusters and possible cordierite porphyroblasts. Essentially barren.

rock_name: Strongly mineralised and altered fine- to medium-grained peridotite
alteration: Partial serpentinisation of olivine/pyroxene with abundant iddingsite; saussurite, talc, carbonate, chlorite
opaque_minerals: Chromite-magnetite-pyrrhotite-chalcopyrite paragenesis; ore lenses 0.5-6.0 mm, pyrrhotite 75-80% of lenses (0.3-8.0 mm) rimmed by chalcopyrite; pentlandite displaced by pyrrhotite/chalcopyrite; magnetite veinlet mesh in serpentine; single sphalerite grains
description_summary: Described as identical to OVD21-116.1 (Innova report): partially serpentinised olivine-pyroxene-hornblende peridotite with strong Ni-Cu sulfide lens mineralisation tied to serpentinisation. Header reads OVD20-121 but microphoto caption reads 21-121 - hole attribution slightly ambiguous.
